Applies to the plasma-boundary outline and not to a plasma-facing component outline
Sign convention: positive in the direction of increasing Z
Unit: m

Volume (V) enclosed inside a magnetic flux surface, i.e. integrated over the full interior of the surface, not the shell between adjacent surfaces (V = ∫_Ω d³x with Ω the region inside the selected surface)
Space outside the selected surface is excluded, and differences between enclosed volumes give the volume between neighbouring surfaces
For nested surfaces the value increases from zero at the magnetic axis and equals the volume enclosed by the plasma boundary when the selected surface is the LCFS
Unit: m^3
The quantity is the angular argument of the complex probing-wave envelope at the wave-beam locus.
It is referenced to the launch phase, i.e. φ_env − φ_launch modulo 2π for a launch-referenced value.
It is the envelope phase, not the carrier oscillation phase.

Phase values differing by an integer number of full revolutions are equivalent; an unwrapped phase selects a continuous branch, and fringe-jump correction changes that representation without changing the phase modulo one revolution.
The sign convention is positive when the envelope phase advances counterclockwise relative to launch using the positive-time-exponent phasor convention.
The unit is rad.
dimensionless scalar factor assigned to the residual of a single interferometer beam
applies per beam, not to an entire interferometer system
enters the weighted objective as w_b * r_b^2, where r_b is the beam's residual between modeled and reference line-integrated electron density
controls the relative influence of that beam's line-integrated electron-density constraint among simultaneously weighted constraints
no summation, averaging, or normalization over multiple beams is implied; each beam has its own weight and residual contribution
unit: 1 (dimensionless)
signed y component of the unit vector along the major axis of an elliptic shatter cone
projection onto the y basis direction of the right-handed Cartesian (x, y, z) frame
positive when the major-axis unit vector has a component in the +y direction
unit is 1
